subject.title: feat(gateway): durable cloud worker environments, provider SDK contract, and lifecycle RPCs

question: After fixing pre-bind corruption handling, should OpenClaw adopt this worker-provider API, cloudWorkers config, lifecycle RPC, and durable-state shape as the permanent milestone-1 contract?
rationale: The startup defect is mechanical, but the exact public API, security model, and persisted-state commitments require explicit maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Adopt after all gates
options.body: Approve the contract after startup recovery, upgrade evidence, security review, and a real provision, restart-adopt, and destroy run are complete.

options.title: Narrow before adoption
options.body: Keep the cloud-worker direction but defer public or persistent surfaces not essential to the first durable substrate.

options.title: Pause the milestone
options.body: Continue architecture work in the canonical issue if maintainers are not ready to commit to these contracts.

recommendation.title: Adopt after all gates
recommendation.body: Approve the contract after startup recovery, upgrade evidence, security review, and a real provision, restart-adopt, and destroy run are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the parent design, current assignment, and implementation series, making this the strongest available product-direction route.
